# Noto Sans Arabic and Noto Sans Devanagari

Fonts for complex scripts, installed in `C:\Windows\Fonts` as
`notosansarabic.ttf` and `notosansdevanagari.ttf`. GDI falls back to them
when text has Arabic or Devanagari characters, and Uniscribe (`usp10.dll`)
shapes that text with HarfBuzz.

Version: Noto 2020-12-25 (Ubuntu `fonts-noto-core` 20201225-2), by Google,
licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see `LICENSE.txt`).
